description: The larger home includes a structural loft with balustrades and landing, 12 real steps, a bed with checked duvet and curtains, kitchen sink/range/hood and island with three reused stools, a fireplace, a widened sofa, coffee table, television console and four-chair dining area. Furniture source is reused read-only from Basic Room and Standard Room, with scene-local modifications and rebaking.
differences: The single perspective gives no measured dimensions. The 9.2 × 7.4m footprint, 4.9m wall height, 2.68m stair rise, hidden backs, landing and support structure are inferred. The reference uses more compact furniture grouping and a small upper window; this candidate simplifies upper-wall decoration and the fireplace silhouette, retains Basic Room plant/scenery detail, and uses a greener rug and simpler cloth. The television faces the sofa, so the review camera sees its back. Lighting is the Mobile renderer with contact AO, without real-time GI.
collision: The staircase uses individual tread boxes and a separate top-landing box meeting the loft edge. The loft has a floor slab, support-post boxes and simple guardrail volumes. These are structural checks, not a gameplay traversal claim; an eventual controller must define its step/climb policy.
